verses.text: Then all the army officers, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people, from the least to the greatest, came

to Jeremiah the prophet and said, "Please listen to our request and pray to the LORD your God for us, for all of us who are left. Once we were many, but now, as you can see, only a few of us are left.
Pray that the LORD your God will tell us where we should go and what we should do."
Jeremiah the prophet answered them, "I have heard you. I will pray to the LORD your God as you have asked. I will tell you everything the LORD answers. I will not hold anything back from you."
Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not do everything the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
Whether it is pleasant or unpleasant, we will obey the LORD our God, to whom we are sending you. Then things will go well for us, because we will obey the LORD our God."
Ten days later the LORD's message came to Jeremiah.
So he called together Johanan son of Kareah, all the army officers with him, and all the people, from the least to the greatest.
He said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says, the one you sent me to with your request:
'If you stay in this land, I will build you up and not tear you down. I will plant you and not pull you up, because I am sorry about the disaster I have brought on you.
Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you fear now. Do not be afraid of him,' says the LORD, 'because I am with you to save you and rescue you from his power.
I will show you mercy, so that he will have mercy on you and let you go back to your own land.'
But suppose you say, 'We will not stay in this land,' and so disobey the LORD your God.
Suppose you say, 'No, we will go to Egypt, where we will not see war or hear the trumpet call to battle or go hungry. We will live there.'
Then listen to the LORD's message, you survivors of Judah. This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: 'If you are determined to go to Egypt and live there,
then the war you fear will catch up with you there in Egypt, and the famine you dread will follow you there to Egypt, and you will die there.
All who are determined to go to Egypt to live there will die by war, famine, and disease. Not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring on them.'

For this is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: 'Just as my anger and fury were poured out on the people of Jerusalem, so my fury will be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will become an object of cursing and horror, of mockery and disgrace. You will never see this place again.'
Survivors of Judah, the LORD has told you, 'Do not go to Egypt!' Be sure of this: I warn you today
that you have made a deadly mistake. You sent me to the LORD your God and said, 'Pray to the LORD our God for us. Tell us everything he says, and we will do it.'
Today I have told you, but you still have not obeyed the LORD your God in anything he sent me to tell you.
So now be sure of this: you will die by war, famine, and disease in the place where you want to go and live."
